content.description: Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of Proxmox tasks from the system. This operation allows authenticated users to query and monitor various background tasks related to Proxmox VE operations.nnThe operation supports complex search, sorting, and pagination options, enabling efficient filtering of tasks by status, creation time, and task type.nnSecurity: Access is restricted to authenticated users who have permission to view Proxmox task statuses and logs. All task data corresponds directly to Proxmox internal task tracking mechanisms, providing real-time operational insight.nnThis operation integrates with the proxmox_paywall_proxmox_tasks Prisma model, reflecting the current schema design and field definitions.

requestBody.description: Search filter and pagination parameters for Proxmox task list retrieval

responseBody.description: Paginated list of Proxmox task summaries matching the search criteria
